about_the_game:
Selling Point

Perform ninjutsu by tying seals with your own hands!

One of the most important features of this game is that the camera recognizes the marks made by the player's hands.

You can experience the experience of activating ninjutsu by quickly making a mark, just like a real ninja.

A camera is required to play this game.

Don't know how to make a mark?

Don't worry, we have a friendly tutorial to help you see the hand shape in 3D.

Game Overview

The player plays the role of the main character, a novice ninja, who uses the ninjutsu he has acquired to fight battles and explore Japan during the Sengoku Period.

Battle

This is a turn-based battle between the player and the enemy.

The player's turn has a time limit, and the player can use ninjutsu as many times as he/she wants within the time limit.

In addition, the faster a mark is made, the more powerful the ninjutsu will be.

In other words, the faster you can make a mark, the more advantageous you will be in the battle!

Enemies with various characteristics will appear on the stage.

(enemies that counterattack every time they are attacked, enemies whose attacks do not work below a certain damage level, enemies whose attack power increases every turn... and so on),

The player's analytical skills and judgment will be tested to determine the characteristics of the enemy and which techniques to use at what timing.

Practice

Practicing asceticism (mini-games) at home can increase a player's status for a while.

The mini-games are a little different from battles in that they allow the player to experience the play of making marks.

Live Broadcast and Distribution

All live-streaming and distribution is permitted, including monetized versions.
